The Trump administration’s top lawyer faced sharp questioning, including from some members of the court’s conservative wing.

content.title: Ford is debating axing the electric F-150, WSJ reports
content.description:
Ford (F) is considering scrapping the F-150 Lightning, the electric version of its popular F-150 pickup truck, according to a report from the Wall Street Journal. A Ford spokesperson told Yahoo Finance the company doesn't comment "on speculation about future product plans." Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian reports the details.
